preferences.name: sessionKey
preferences.title: Session Key
preferences.description: Your claude.ai sessionKey cookie (starts with sk-ant-sid…). In a browser signed in to claude.ai, open devtools → Application → Cookies → https://claude.ai → copy the value of the sessionKey cookie. It is stored in Raycast's encrypted preferences and is only ever sent to claude.ai.
